text:
priyanka: Quick design check — I pushed a small update to the Roles matrix layout and the Invite drawer copy. Can we decide where the SSO enforcement toggle should live? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see frame 'RBAC - v7')

matt: glanced — nice cleanup. My vote: keep SSO enforcement in Org Settings > Security, not the Roles panel. Roles is already dense.

elaine: strong agree with @matt. Putting enforcement in Security keeps mental model single source of truth for auth. Also accessibility note: the current toggle color contrast is failing 3:1 for the inactive state.

jordan: +1 on separation. One practical ask — if someone flips SSO on, we should show a small inline banner in the invite drawer: "SSO enabled — external invites require approval". That helps avoid surprise.

sam: love the banner idea. Quick copy options:
```
Option A: "SSO is enabled for this org. External invites will require admin approval."
Option B: "SSO active — invitees must authenticate via SSO. Admin approval required for external domains."
Option C: "SSO enabled. Invites outside your organization will be gated by admin approval."
```
Which do we prefer? I lean A for brevity.

priyanka: A is fine. Also thinking about keyboard nav in the Roles matrix — when you open a role row menu, focus should land on the first actionable item (Edit, Assign) and pressing Esc should close the menu and return focus to the three-dot trigger. Small a11y win.

elaine: noted — I'll add that to the spec. Also suggest increasing hit area for the three-dot trigger to 44px. Mobile/touch feels brittle.

jordan: For audit log nav: people keep asking for a persistent filter for "SSO changes" and "Invites". Can we add quick chips above results? e.g., [All] [Invites] [SSO changes] [Role changes] — selecting a chip applies filters and remains sticky per user.

matt: chips make sense. Backend-wise Sam, is there already indexed event types for those?

sam: yes, events have type: invite.create, sso.toggle, role.update. We can surface those as chips without infra changes. We'll need to add a tooltip explaining retention window (90 days by default).

tao: design-bot: small prototype attached — I updated the invite drawer to show the SSO banner and moved the secondary help link into the footer. Accessibility checklist: label for toggle, 44px hit targets, visible focus styles. https://figma.com/proto/abc

priyanka: Perfect. Can we also tweak the invite microcopy to reduce friction when SSO is on? Suggested line under email input: "Invited users must sign in with your org's SSO provider." Short and actionable.

elaine: that copy reads well. I'll run a quick contrast check and push an a11y update.

matt: one more ops note — when SSO is turned on org-wide, old invite links should not break silently. Add a small inline note near the top of the invites page: "Existing invite links may require SSO sign-in."

priyanka: good catch. I'll add that to the rollout checklist. Thanks team :thumbsup:

design-bot: deploy-preview generated for the Roles + Invite UI changes: https://deploy-preview.internal/redwood/rbac-v7 — please test in staging.

sam: will validate event types + retention tooltip tomorrow and post results here.

jordan: assigning follow-ups: @elaine (a11y fixes + copy), @sam (events validation), @matt (add banner spec), @priyanka (rollout checklist).

priyanka: thanks all — closing this thread once staging sign-off is in.
